name: Listening to music
intro: Where the catalog, sound and playlists are easy to use, and where your saved music gets lost.

apps.title: Spotify: Music and Podcasts
apps.verdict: A mature streaming service with a strong recommendation engine and an enormous catalog. Its one core product flaw: the shuffle algorithm keeps cycling through the same 20 tracks from a thousand-song playlist.
apps.loved: Personalized mixes and stations reliably match the mood and regularly surface new artists.
apps.weak: The shuffle algorithm loops through the same songs instead of covering the full playlist evenly.
apps.whoFor: Listeners who care about personalization and discovering new music

quotes.text: Please for the love of god fix your SHUFFLE. It is absolutely terrible. I'm tired of hearing the same songs over and over and over with shuffle on.

i've been using spotify since 2022 now and every night to sleep i play music on my tv in my room. dark mode has never been an issue, i've loved it all the years i've used it since it prevents light from being in my face when i'm trying to sleep. so imagine my surprise when spotify makes the grand de
it's pretty chill, i have premium so i don't have to deal with the adds but i lowk wish spotify messages didn't exist because i have one desperate ex…🫩💔🥀
So buggy, I can't hop onto a jam with my Girlfriend without it completely glitching out on me. This app used to be so good and now it's just buns!

apps.title: IDAGIO Stream Classical Music
apps.verdict: The best specialized service for classical music fans: the catalog is organized by work and performer, not just by album, which is critical for the genre. The mood feature is accurate, and the ability to compare multiple recordings of the same piece is unique in the market.
apps.loved: Navigation by work with the ability to compare multiple performances of the same symphony or sonata is not available on any mainstream streaming service.
apps.weak: Navigating large catalogs is awkward because there is no quick alphabetical jump, so you have to scroll through thousands of names manually.
apps.whoFor: Classical music fans who need to find specific works and performers rather than just streaming background audio

quotes.text: I've subscribed to IDAGIO for years. I love their "mood" feature and the broad range of music they offer. This isn't the "top ten" of classical. I've been introduced to composers new to me and stretched my listening range. Thank you, IDAGIO.

apps.title: Apple Music Classical
apps.verdict: A specialized classical library with proper attribution by conductor, orchestra, and period that fills a gap no mainstream streaming service covers. Weak spots include slow scrolling, no proper playlist shuffle, and limited Indian classical coverage.
apps.loved: Deep catalog organization by performer and era that is not available in ordinary music services.
apps.weak: Long playlists scroll slowly, and the shuffle function only works through the main Apple Music app.
apps.whoFor: Classical fans who need correct attribution and catalog depth

quotes.text: There is a surprising lack of curation and content related to Indian and Carnatic classical music. Ali Akbar Khan is not on here? Really?

apps.title: Plexamp
apps.verdict: The best option for people who want to stream their own library in high quality from any device. FLAC support, gapless playback, and smart rediscovery of a personal collection set it apart. Shuffle repeats the same order, the CarPlay interface is sparse, and navigation takes some getting used to.
apps.loved: Stream your own FLAC files from anywhere via a Plex server without paying for a catalog.
apps.weak: Shuffle mode plays tracks in the same order every time it starts.
apps.whoFor: Collectors with a personal music library who want to stream their own files

quotes.text: I enjoy using the app. Needs some work in shuffle mode, as it plays the same songs in the same order every time I use the app.

Hundreds of cd, too many steaming services, and enough technical knowledge to get me in trouble. Sent up plex media server with plex pass lifetime and I'm now able to stream my own music via plexamp anywhere. Saved me hundreds per year. Goodbye Spotify!

apps.title: Radio and Music Online (Радио)
apps.verdict: A reliable Russian-language radio aggregator with a good station selection, stable streams, and CarPlay support. Navigation through the large list is awkward, and individual stations drop out occasionally.
apps.loved: A wide selection of Russian radio stations in one place, including rare and regional ones.
apps.weak: Navigating hundreds of stations is awkward and it is easy to lose the one you want.
apps.whoFor: Russian-speaking listeners abroad and fans of specific Russian stations

apps.title: SoundCloud: The Music You Love
apps.verdict: The only platform with real access to unreleased tracks, demos, and independent artists. The interface lags well behind Spotify in terms of organizational convenience, and AI-generated music in the feed degrades the quality of discovery.
apps.loved: A catalog of unreleased tracks, demos, and rarities that is unavailable on any other major platform.
apps.weak: There are no tools to train the feed: you cannot flag a disliked artist and they keep appearing in recommendations.
apps.whoFor: Underground music fans, DJs, and people who follow artists before their official releases

quotes.text: the reason it's hella cool and amazing is because you can find every unreleased song ever I usually listen to unreleased stuff on here and then spotify but I recommend this for people who want to listen to unreleased music or start off a rap career.10/10

love how it's so easy to get a platform and find new artists and build a portfolio but SoundCloud itself isn't supportive to small artists which is a shame but I appreciate the platform it provides to them

apps.title: Apple Music
apps.verdict: A catalog of over 100 million tracks and lossless audio quality make Apple Music a strong choice for audiophiles within the Apple ecosystem. The interface gets redesigned regularly without improving navigation logic, and the recommendation algorithm is slow to learn the user's taste.
apps.loved: Audio quality is flawless, and integration with Apple devices and CarPlay is frictionless.
apps.weak: The recommendation algorithm is hard to train to your taste: the app stubbornly pushes popular music instead of niche picks.
apps.whoFor: Audiophiles in the Apple ecosystem with an already well-formed music taste

quotes.text: I use this platform to connect with God through music. Sometimes when life gets so unbearable. I can listen to music that revitalizes my spirit and gives me strength to conquer the day one one day at a time…
So, do y'all know the song "YARARARA" by AnythingBecomeMoe? Well, if y'all haven't heard it, it's AWESOME, and I loved it so much but was blocked from my country today(the United States)

apps.title: Mixcloud: Music, Mixes & Radio
apps.verdict: Mixcloud remains the best place for DJ mixes, club sets, and alternative radio, but removing the 30-second skip button and declining stability in 2025-2026 have frustrated long-time users.
apps.loved: The only service with a real library of DJ sets and live mixes from thousands of artists.
apps.weak: The 30-second skip was removed and navigation within long mixes is restricted without a subscription.
apps.whoFor: Electronic music fans, club set listeners, and DJ mix enthusiasts

apps.title: Qobuz: Music & Editorial
apps.verdict: Qobuz wins on audio quality and fair treatment of artists, which builds a loyal audience willing to tolerate its shortcomings. Unstable playback and weak recommendation algorithms prevent it from becoming a full replacement for Spotify for users accustomed to modern streaming convenience.
apps.loved: The high-resolution audio is genuinely audible without extra equipment, especially in the car and on good headphones.
apps.weak: The personalization algorithm is extremely weak: there is no way to block overplayed tracks, and daily and weekly picks are predictable and repetitive.
apps.whoFor: Audiophiles and people who want to support artists financially without sacrificing sound quality

quotes.text: I tried to wait for qobuz to get it together, waiting for the app to get better, for me to stop crashing out everytime the app would stop working or would recommend me the same garbage song, that I hate that I coincidentally can't block becuase no such feature exists.

apps.title: CloudBeats: Cloud Music Player
apps.verdict: The best choice for listeners who store their own collection on OneDrive or Google Drive: supports large libraries, offline caching, and CarPlay. Scanning collections above 15,000 tracks is slow, and playlist creation is cumbersome.
apps.loved: The only player in this niche that actually reads a large personal collection from the cloud.
apps.weak: Creating and managing playlists is cumbersome with large libraries.
apps.whoFor: Music collectors with their own collection on a cloud drive

apps.title: Shazam: Find Music & Concerts
apps.verdict: Best-in-class music recognition for modern tracks from popular platforms. Historical and live recordings are recognized inconsistently, and the Shazam history periodically loses saved results.
apps.loved: Instantly identifies most modern tracks and immediately offers to open them in your favorite streaming app.
apps.weak: Older and live music recognition is hit or miss, and the Shazam history is unstable and loses entries.
apps.whoFor: People who frequently hear unfamiliar tracks and want to identify them quickly

quotes.text: Finds newer singers but not so good at finding singers from before 2000's

On multiple occasions I have tried Shazam on songs that I already knew the name of and Shazam keeps getting it wrong. If anything, I wish there was a button that said "Got it wrong? Type the song name below" or at least something like that.

apps.title: Echo - Rank music!
apps.verdict: A strong concept for people who want to keep a listening diary and rank albums the way Letterboxd works for films. The community is active, the developer is responsive, but the app crashes and lags frequently enough to make it hard to use.
apps.loved: A community of genuine music enthusiasts and an attentive developer create a rare sense of trust.
apps.weak: You cannot log a listen with a past date, which breaks the diary-keeping experience.
apps.whoFor: Listeners who enjoy consciously tracking and rating albums

apps.title: Jango Radio - Streaming Music
apps.verdict: Free internet radio with artist-based personalization that is stable and ad-free for most users. The main product flaw: the recommendation algorithm occasionally inserts tracks from the wrong genre, and there is no search for specific songs.
apps.loved: Listeners note that they can listen to similar music for hours without a subscription and without ad interruptions.
apps.weak: The station algorithm inserts off-genre tracks into the stream, especially when independent artists are added.
apps.whoFor: People who want free mood-based radio without fiddling with settings

apps.title: TuneIn Radio: Music & Sports
apps.verdict: The best live radio aggregator in the world: thousands of stations from different countries, sports broadcasts, and niche formats like Coast to Coast AM. Background playback occasionally stops after a signal loss and does not resume automatically.
apps.loved: Access to live international radio from any country without a VPN, all in one place.
apps.weak: Background playback is unstable: after a brief connection drop the stream does not resume automatically.
apps.whoFor: Fans of live radio, sports broadcasts, and niche formats from around the world

quotes.text: When trying to hit a channel, I sometimes have to hear at least 30 min of commercials. Mostly repeated over and over. I don't mind commercials but that amount is too much. I finally have to close the app and try sharing.

apps.title: TIDAL Music: HiFi Sound
apps.verdict: Tidal offers the best audio quality in the category and a wider catalog than most competitors, but offline downloads are unreliable, search requires exact spelling, and aggressive rating prompts annoy even loyal users.
apps.loved: Audio quality is noticeably better than Spotify, especially on good hardware.
apps.weak: Offline mode is unstable: downloaded playlists are sometimes unavailable when there is no network.
apps.whoFor: Audiophiles and music fans willing to pay for sound quality

quotes.text: I broke up with Spotify and had a rebound with Tidal. I had high hopes, and have tried to stick with it, but the offline/download functionality just sucks. I have a long commute without cell service and need to reliably download music. Goodbye Tidal
Tidal please get it together. Why do songs go dim on playlists with the note saying it can't be played in my area? (A US band being played in the US??) Quality control is lacking

apps.title: Offline Music Player
apps.verdict: One of the best standalone players on iOS for people who store their own music: thoughtful import, metadata editing, EQ, and background playback all work reliably. Occasional crashes after updates and the removal of the play-count sort feature noticeably hurt the experience.
apps.loved: Metadata editing directly in the app and stable background playback.
apps.weak: After updates, favorite features sometimes disappear and the developer does not bring them back.
apps.whoFor: Owners of mp3 collections who need a powerful offline player

quotes.text: Didn't pay for anything you can download anything and play it but only while the apps open turn off your phone, switch apps, or even go to your Home Screen instantly stops playing
Please, I beg you to return the function of sorting by the number of times you listened to a song, this is a unique feature that other applications do not have, please return it.

apps.title: Stingray Music: 100s of DJs
apps.verdict: Excellent radio-format streaming with a rich genre selection for listeners who do not want to build playlists themselves. You cannot search for or play a specific artist or track, only themed channels.
apps.loved: Broad genre coverage from old-school soul to instrumental jazz with nothing to configure.
apps.weak: There is no way to find and play a specific artist or song, only preset channels.
apps.whoFor: Background listeners who enjoy a radio format without having to pick tracks

apps.title: Deezer: Music Player, Podcast
apps.verdict: Deezer offers a solid streaming catalog with good audio quality and decent recommendations, and stands out for the ability to block unwanted artists. Downsides are product-level: uneven volume between tracks, occasional CarPlay glitches, and a somewhat confusing UX on first launch.
apps.loved: Audio quality is noticeably better than competitors, and you can block individual artists directly in settings.
apps.weak: Volume jumps between tracks without normalization, and CarPlay periodically loses the playback queue.
apps.whoFor: People who value audio quality and are looking for a Spotify alternative

quotes.text: I want to like Deezer because I can't stand Spotify, but the one function that I really look for in music apps is the ability to download for offline use because I don't have unlimited data. However, it seems that even if I waste space on my phone downloading the music for offline use (in & out of o

When using Apple Carplay Deezer will just suddenly stop and there will be no songs in the queue. Happens about once every four hours of driving even with full bars of 5G. Beyond that nuisance Deezer is fantastic!

apps.title: Evermusic: Cloud Music Player
apps.verdict: One of the best options for listeners with their own collection: supports cloud storage, has a tag editor, and library filtering. The key downside is that the monetization model has shifted against users and ads in the free version have become aggressive, including fraudulent banners.
apps.loved: Connecting to multiple cloud storage services simultaneously and full search with filtering across a large library work better than competitors.
apps.weak: Album artwork cannot be edited through the built-in tag editor, even though all other fields are available for editing.
apps.whoFor: Music fans with a personal collection in the cloud who want to listen to their own music without being tied to streaming services

quotes.text: i'm a niche music freak and streaming platforms really push me away with either an overabundance of ads or a lot of the songs i like simply not being available. this app solves both of my problems AND i get to sort my music on my phone everywhere just like i do on my desktop at home!

apps.title: Pandora: Music & Podcasts
apps.verdict: A pioneer of taste-algorithm radio stations: works well for background listening when you do not want to build playlists. The key flaw is that a station created around an artist drifts far from the original artist over time.
apps.loved: The Music Genome algorithm builds a stream of similar tracks without any effort from the user.
apps.weak: A station tuned to a specific artist quickly drifts toward unrelated music.
apps.whoFor: Fans of the radio format without manual playlist control

quotes.text: I updated Pandora and it totally wiped my account! I had to sign in and choose stations all over again. I had my "curated list" - YOU deleted it. Not good, Pandora.
Some people have a playlist they like to listen to but, I like the variety and random new tracks and artists that a radio station offers🤷🙌🥰

apps.title: Flacbox: Hi-Res Music Player
apps.verdict: The best local FLAC player on iOS with a customizable interface and equalizer. Playlists sometimes get stuck on the first track, large files cause crashes, and navigation requires some adjustment.
apps.loved: The only reliable option for playing a FLAC collection without compression on iOS.
apps.weak: Playlists get stuck on the first track after an iOS update, and large lossless files periodically cause crashes.
apps.whoFor: Audiophiles with a personal FLAC collection on iOS

quotes.text: 😭 this is the BEST music player on iOS, I would pay full for the eq alone, pls give us higher and more bands 🥹
I've tried almost all of the very few audio players on iOS that support FLAC files and this one is by far the best and the only one I have had consistently work without fail.

apps.title: VLC media player
apps.verdict: VLC on iOS reliably plays local collections in any format including FLAC, but the mobile interface lags behind the desktop version: no search bar, Bluetooth connection cuts the beginning of tracks, and gapless playback does not work.
apps.loved: Support for any file format and playback with the screen off, no subscriptions required.
apps.weak: With Bluetooth connected, the start of each track is cut off by about a second, which breaks smooth listening.
apps.whoFor: Audiophiles with their own FLAC and rare-format collection

apps.title: E-Radio - Stream greek music
apps.verdict: The only specialized app for Greek radio serving the diaspora abroad. Basic functionality works well, but stability drops after updates: crashes, lost favorites, non-working stations.
apps.loved: Wide coverage of Greek radio stations for listeners outside Greece.
apps.weak: After updates the app loses stability: saved stations disappear and some streams stop working.
apps.whoFor: The Greek diaspora in the US, Australia, and other countries

apps.title: Cs Music Pro
apps.verdict: The best interface for navigating a personal music library on iOS: sorting, queues, and customization are better than Apple Music. The problem is that recent updates have broken launch stability and some users are leaving.
apps.loved: Lets you see and manage your personal music collection the way you want, without an imposed streaming interface.
apps.weak: After recent updates the app freezes on launch and requires several attempts to open.
apps.whoFor: Owners of large personal collections on-device who do not want Apple Music

apps.title: Audiomack - Play Music Offline
apps.verdict: A strong position in the hip-hop and independent artist niche: tracks available here are not on Spotify. The Audiomod feature with tempo change and reverb directly in the player sets the app apart, though the mainstream catalog is incomplete.
apps.loved: Tracks from independent and emerging artists are available for free and in good quality.
apps.weak: A significant portion of mainstream and international artists are absent from the platform or only partially represented.
apps.whoFor: Hip-hop, indie, and new artist listeners who value access to exclusive content

quotes.text: I really love using the Audiomod feature to speed up or slow down tracks, but I wish the app handled it better. Right now, if I turn on a mod, it stays on for every single song I play. I want to be able to apply certain Audiomods to specific songs and have them stay saved only for those tracks.

apps.title: Anghami: Play Music & Podcasts
apps.verdict: Anghami occupies a unique niche as the best streaming service for Arabic-language content, but a notable portion of the international catalog is unavailable or disappears without warning, and playlist sorting does not persist between sessions.
apps.loved: The best Arabic music coverage among all streaming services.
apps.weak: The catalog is unstable: popular tracks go unavailable without explanation, and playlist sorting resets.
apps.whoFor: Listeners of Arabic and Middle Eastern music

quotes.text: I have been a loyal user for more that 6 years where I lived in MENA countries, after immigrating to USA , I was surprised that app isn't available here. I truly love this app and I hope you consider expanding it globally so users can continue enjoying it no matter where they live.

apps.title: Country Radio: Streaming Music
apps.verdict: Simple country-themed streaming radio that delivers the genre listeners want without extra setup. The main weakness is that the stream periodically drops after a few minutes of playback.
apps.loved: Wide coverage of country styles from old-school to new releases in a single stream without manual searching.
apps.weak: The stream regularly stops on its own after 5-10 minutes and has to be restarted manually.
apps.whoFor: Country fans who want background radio without picking tracks

apps.title: VOX – MP3 & FLAC Music Player
apps.verdict: One of the best players for FLAC and personal collections, with a parametric equalizer and Last.fm scrobbling. Over the past year, problems with VOX Cloud sync, CarPlay, and playback reliability have been mounting.
apps.loved: A parametric equalizer, FLAC support, and SoundCloud integration without ads in one player.
apps.weak: Sync between devices via VOX Cloud is unreliable and frequently breaks.
apps.whoFor: Audiophiles with personal FLAC collections and high audio quality requirements

apps.title: NCT - NhacCuaTui Nghe MP3
apps.verdict: NhacCuaTui is strong on Vietnamese music catalog and offline mode, and part of its audience has been using it for over six years. Product issues include limited reach beyond Vietnamese music, tracks disappearing during playlist imports, and broken integration with external speakers (SONOS).
apps.loved: An extensive Vietnamese catalog with offline mode and years of stable operation.
apps.weak: When transferring playlists from other services most tracks are lost, and SONOS integration is broken.
apps.whoFor: Vietnamese-speaking audiences who need a native music catalog

apps.title: iHeart: Radio, Music, Podcasts
apps.verdict: iHeart is strong as a radio station aggregator and for accessing broadcasts from across the country, but as a music player it is weak: you cannot choose a specific track, the algorithm mixes genres arbitrarily, and there is no offline mode at all.
apps.loved: You can listen to your favorite local station from anywhere in the country.
apps.weak: The catalog works like radio, not a player: no track selection and no queue management.
apps.whoFor: Traditional radio fans who need broadcast access while on the go

quotes.text: The app always crashes within 1-3 mins of opening in CarPlay. It crashes when it shares CarPlay space with another app (eg Waze) or apps. This needs to be fixed asap!

I like iHeart radio but I've been listening to Micheal Jackson and the Jackson 5 a lot and when the first song is done it puts on a random song other than Micheal Jackson and the Jackson 5. So what I want is just PLEASE put all Micheal Jackson and Jackson 5 in the radio other than random stuff.
I used to live on Cape Cod, and I listen to WBZ all the time on my commute. I live in Atlanta now, and it's nice. I can still listen to a little bit of Home.

apps.title: Youtify - Music & Playlists
apps.verdict: An affordable Spotify alternative with playlist import from other services attracts users who need flexibility without the high price. The key problem is unstable playback: shuffle freezes, the queue behaves unpredictably, and this gets in the way of daily use.
apps.loved: The ability to import ready-made playlists from Spotify and other services without manual entry saves hours when switching platforms.
apps.weak: Shuffle mode regularly freezes on a few tracks and stops playing instead of cycling through the full collection.
apps.whoFor: Former Spotify users looking for a more affordable replacement while keeping their playlists

apps.title: Audiomack Creator-Upload Music
apps.verdict: Audiomack Creator addresses a real need for independent artists: publish a track and reach an audience without intermediaries. The platform works as a showcase for niche and street sounds, but the technical tools are weak: uploads fail after updates, payouts arrive with major delays, and track metadata editing regularly breaks.
apps.loved: Independent artists can publish music and build an audience without a label and without paying for placement.
apps.weak: Release management tools are unstable: reordering tracks in an album is buggy, and uploads periodically stop working after updates.
apps.whoFor: Independent musicians who want to release tracks and find listeners without a label

apps.title: Audify Music Player
apps.verdict: A local player with a convenient interface and playlists, but recent updates have broken search and destabilized playback. Basic functionality works, though product degradation is visible in reviews spanning several years of use.
apps.loved: Users value custom playlists with cover art and convenient organization of the local library.
apps.weak: Library search periodically fails, and playlists lose their track order on their own.
apps.whoFor: Listeners with their own downloaded collection who do not use streaming

apps.title: PartyTu
apps.verdict: PartyTu fills a real niche: background YouTube playback with custom playlists and no streaming service ads. The product works, but periodically enters a state where all videos go black for several days, track switching takes 30 seconds, and the 300-item playlist limit constrains heavy users.
apps.loved: Background playback of YouTube videos with the ability to sync your playlists, ad-free.
apps.weak: Periodically the entire app fails to load videos for several days in a row without explanation.
apps.whoFor: People who listen to music through YouTube playlists with the screen locked

apps.title: Offline Music - Weezer Player
apps.verdict: It can download tracks from YouTube and play them offline, which gets the job done, but ads interrupt every action for 20-30 seconds and the downloader periodically stops working and requires a reinstall.
apps.loved: Supports importing files from the phone and YouTube links simultaneously.
apps.weak: Search in downloaded tracks works by artist name, not song title.
apps.whoFor: People who want to listen to YouTube tracks offline without a subscription

apps.title: Amazon Music: Songs & Podcasts
apps.verdict: The catalog is broad enough and stream quality is high, but the app suffers from product gaps: shuffle plays the same order every time it starts, adding tracks to playlists consistently breaks after updates, and there is no widget.
apps.loved: High-quality streaming is reliable, and access to audiobooks in the same app is convenient.
apps.weak: Shuffle generates the same pseudo-random order on every launch instead of truly random playback.
apps.whoFor: Amazon Prime subscribers who need a background player without extra effort

quotes.text: It locks itself into loops. Plays music not on playlist. Shuffle does not work, it recreates the same shuffle every time so you hear it in an order instead of a shuffle.

apps.title: SoundHound - Music Discovery
apps.verdict: SoundHound can find songs by humming, which sets it apart from competitors, but degraded recognition accuracy has become a widespread complaint: well-known tracks go unrecognized where Shazam identifies them in five seconds.
apps.loved: Recognizes a song from a hummed melody without words, something Shazam cannot do.
apps.weak: Music recognition accuracy has noticeably declined and now falls behind competitors on popular tracks.
apps.whoFor: People who often recall a melody but do not remember the words or artist

quotes.text: SH hasn't found a song in weeks. Lay the phone next to speaker? Nothing. Don't even ask it to find music without words (Impossible Germany - Wilco!) and Shazam found it in 5 seconds. SH could not find it after 3min
either i have perfect pitch and a naturally beautiful singing voice or this app is good at figuring out what song you're singing because it finds the song i'm looking for pretty consistently

apps.title: stats.fm for Spotify Music App
apps.verdict: Stats.fm was an excellent tool for tracking listening history and comparing tastes with friends, but data accuracy now falls short: missed minutes, incorrect first-listen dates, and broken Apple Music integration. The Soulmates feature, valued by many for connecting with people through music taste, has been removed.
apps.loved: Detailed lifetime listening history broken down by track, artist, and time period.
apps.weak: Statistics have become inaccurate: listens disappear, dates shift, and Apple Music sync periodically breaks.
apps.whoFor: Fans who want to track and compare their music history

quotes.text: So much of the app has not only been paywalled but covered with ads. Double pop-ups with a timer before you can close them to see a single chart, then animated banner ads that slow and bloat the entire app!
App works great, love being able to see my top tracks and artists plus how much I have played a song
Got the lifetime premium for the soulmates function so I could meet people with similar tastes and make some new friends. Feature got removed and my payment was for nothing. Bring back soulmates

apps.title: HEOS
apps.verdict: An app for managing the Denon and Marantz ecosystem that fulfills its role as a multi-room zone controller, but connection instability and integration issues with third-party services like Spotify and Qobuz undermine its core purpose. Users note progress over the years, but basic scenarios still require workarounds.
apps.loved: A single control point for multiple zones and audio sources in the home is genuinely convenient for Denon hardware owners.
apps.weak: Stereo pairs and group playback regularly break after a restart, forcing you to reconfigure everything from scratch each time.
apps.whoFor: Owners of Denon or Marantz receivers and speakers

apps.title: Lyra - Music, Radio, eSound
apps.verdict: The concept is strong: import playlists from YouTube, background playback, and no ads make Lyra an attractive alternative to paid streaming. But the app systematically substitutes the wrong tracks (plays an AI cover or a completely different song), sessions crash mid-drive, and playlists disappear without warning.
apps.loved: Import a YouTube playlist with one tap and zero ads during playback.
apps.weak: Search matching frequently returns the wrong song or an AI cover instead of the original.
apps.whoFor: People who want to listen to YouTube playlists in the background without a subscription

apps.title: GoPlayer: cloud music player
apps.verdict: The best player for personal collections on Google Drive: finds and plays files where others fail, but suffers from crashes on track changes, freezes, and periodic loss of the entire library.
apps.loved: The only iOS player that comfortably plays an mp3 collection directly from Google Drive without extra steps.
apps.weak: No support for cloud storage services other than Google Drive.
apps.whoFor: Music fans with a personal collection in Google Drive

apps.title: Musicana - Organizer & Player
apps.verdict: Musicana found its audience as a replacement for Musi after it left the App Store, but playback is unstable, ads interrupt tracks and prevent controlling the player during display, and the offline storage limit is annoying.
apps.loved: A large catalog via YouTube backend and an interface that makes sense from the first launch.
apps.weak: Ads interrupt playback and block the controls while they are showing.
apps.whoFor: Former Musi users looking for a free alternative with a similar concept

apps.title: Silence Music: Equalizer, Musi
apps.verdict: Free access to the full YouTube catalog with a customizable equalizer is appealing, but systematic 'No Streams Available' errors make listening unreliable.
apps.loved: The full YouTube catalog plus a real equalizer with a bass boost preset.
apps.weak: Playback regularly breaks with a stream error, and the problem does not go away after restarting.
apps.whoFor: Listeners who want YouTube music for free without a streaming subscription

quotes.text: Hey, I really like this app the sound is solid and the EQ is actually nice to use. But I noticed a bug with the bass and treble knobs. If I set bass or treble to around 50%, then switch to a different preset, the knob might show something lower like 30%, but it still sounds like it's stuck at the

apps.title: JioSaavn – Music & Podcasts
apps.verdict: JioSaavn is strong on the Indian catalog and performs reasonably well on the go, but the recommendation algorithm is stuck on the same 30 tracks, CarPlay has serious glitches, and the library is shrinking.
apps.loved: Deep Indian catalog with rare regional-language versions of tracks.
apps.weak: The recommendation algorithm cycles through the same 30 songs with no way to break into new music.
apps.whoFor: Listeners of Bollywood and regional Indian music

quotes.text: This app has one of the worst algorithms for playlists. The same 30 songs play on repeat and it's impossible to escape them. Even if I play a song from 1970, the following song will be 1/30 repeat songs. It's obnoxious and impossible to discover new music.

First, if it wasn't for CarPlay Interface, I would give 5 stars. But, my primary use of this app is in the car, Apple CarPlay interface is important to me. CarPlay interface for this app hangs, doesn't play the right song, play song from a list instead what's chosen on the CarPlay screen.

apps.title: Stationhead
apps.verdict: A unique idea for communal listening with a fan community and a stream counter that found its audience, but aggressively moving previously free features behind a paywall eroded trust among active users. Technical stability problems during live broadcasts make the situation worse.
apps.loved: The radio show format with a live host and a shared chat creates a sense of community around a favorite artist.
apps.weak: Music sync is unstable under peak load, and notification delays about the start of broadcasts make them nearly useless.
apps.whoFor: Active fans of specific artists who want to listen to music together with the community

quotes.text: Why do we need to pay to access everything now I understand paying to see how many minutes I've streamed , but please can you at least just make my daily streams free I love checking how many streams i do everyday 😭

apps.title: RaMusi: Offline Music Player
apps.verdict: Works as an offline player with a wide catalog and a similar-track recommendation algorithm, but ads are aggressive (1-3 minutes before every action), and the advertised offline mode requires a paid subscription that some users find does not work.
apps.loved: The algorithm adapts to taste and suggests unfamiliar tracks that hit the mark.
apps.weak: You cannot delete a single song from a playlist without deleting the entire playlist.
apps.whoFor: People who want to discover new music without a Spotify subscription

apps.title: Cloud Music Player - Listener
apps.verdict: A utilitarian offline player with Wi-Fi file transfer attracts those who need to listen to their own collection without internet, but adding and removing tracks remains unnecessarily complex. Audio compression on import and instability with large libraries reduce practical value.
apps.loved: Transferring music over Wi-Fi without connecting to a computer works conveniently for small collections up to a few hundred tracks.
apps.weak: Audio quality degrades after import: the app appears to reduce bitrate when adding tracks to the library.
apps.whoFor: Users with a small personal collection who need a simple offline player without cloud

quotes.text: I was using this app because it seemed perfect for what I needed. But after comparing the sound of files before and after importing into this app, the sound is changed drastically. It has nothing to do with the equalizer (I tried every setting anyways), it simply sounds like the bitrate is lowered.

apps.title: YouTube Music
apps.verdict: A unique catalog thanks to YouTube videos and live recordings, but as a music player the app systematically breaks: the algorithm stopped taking likes and dislikes into account, search periodically fails to find well-known artists, and offline playlists load slowly even for local files.
apps.loved: Access to live performances, covers, and rare recordings not available in traditional catalogs.
apps.weak: The recommendation algorithm has stopped learning the listener's taste and mixes genres despite explicit signals.
apps.whoFor: Listeners who need access to YouTube content in a player format

quotes.text: Siri was broken for a couple days after an update but it seems to be working now? At least half the time.. Only thing that needs improving is CarPlay. It's lacking features.

I'm not sure what happened to the algorithm over the past six months to a year but it changed. Ever since then it started mixing genres and playing artists that I never listen to. Or it thinks that since I listen to some pop music on occasion that I must love all pop music even though I've disliked

apps.title: TREBEL Music - Download Songs
apps.verdict: TREBEL built its advantage on offline playback without a subscription, but introducing a daily track limit and storage restrictions made the core value proposition unworkable: users are leaving for the exact reason they came.
apps.loved: Offline playback without internet in dead zones, mountains, and airplanes.
apps.weak: The daily listening limit completely breaks the long-drive-without-connectivity scenario.
apps.whoFor: People who listen to music in areas without internet and do not want to pay for streaming

quotes.text: Used to be great although after it updated the app you can only now listen to a certain number of songs a day and only have the songs downloaded to the device for 2 days ,which was a pain when I went to vacation in a rural area without WiFi.

apps.title: Rockbot - Request Music
apps.verdict: Rockbot solves a narrow problem: voting for music in a cafe or venue, but the venue algorithm regularly ignores submitted requests, and the catalog is noticeably thin across certain genres. The 'DJ level' mechanic and the three-tracks-per-artist limit within 48 hours frustrate those who just want to control the stream.
apps.loved: The feeling that your vote influences what plays in a shared space.
apps.weak: The venue algorithm overrides voted tracks, which makes the request mechanic pointless.
apps.whoFor: Visitors to venues that run Rockbot

apps.title: LiveOne Music
apps.verdict: Once a beloved radio service with a deep history (Yahoo Radio, Slacker), but a serious overheating and battery drain problem on modern iPhones makes it practically uncomfortable for everyday use. The curated stations still stand out, but the current technical state outweighs that.
apps.loved: Genre and mood curated stations are put together thoughtfully and do not resemble the algorithmic output of competitors.
apps.weak: Station personalization has degraded: favorite tracks are pushed out by random recommendations and control over the selection has become significantly worse.
apps.whoFor: Niche genre fans willing to accept the limitations of a radio format

quotes.text: LiveOne used to be a great app. The Favorite Mashup Station played mostly the songs I had hearted or favorited, with only a few random suggestions mixed in. Recently, that has changed a lot. Now it plays too many random suggestions that are not close to what I like. Maybe 1 in 5 songs are one Thar o

The curated stations are simply the best. Thoughtful and entertaining stations keep me coming back! The algorithms for related songs and artists can sometimes be a bit off target, there's always room for improvement. Absolutely recommend!

apps.title: Music TV - Video Play & Stream
apps.verdict: Music TV is positioned as a video player with YouTube integration and works decently for that on a TV, but YouTube playlist import is unstable and the app regularly crashes when working with cached videos.
apps.loved: Convenient music video playback on a large screen via AirPlay or a television.
apps.weak: YouTube playlist import does not show all entries and often does not fully sync.
apps.whoFor: People who want to watch music videos on a TV

apps.title: MyMusic - Audio Player
apps.verdict: MyMusic is a simple local mp3 player that handles the basic task with the paid ad-free version. In the free version, banners cover the screen and block controls, the skip button sticks after three presses, and users report the entire device slowing down after installation.
apps.loved: The paid version at a modest price gives a clean player with support for 400+ local mp3 files and no ads.
apps.weak: You cannot add a folder of tracks at once, only one file at a time.
apps.whoFor: People who store a large local mp3 collection and are willing to pay to remove ads

apps.title: Mp3 Player Offline
apps.verdict: The player searches and downloads music from multiple sources, which sets it apart from competitors. Library organization is primitive: no alphabetical sorting, and adding to playlists is cumbersome.
apps.loved: Actually finds and downloads tracks through multiple search engines, including obscure ones.
apps.weak: The library has no sorting. Adding tracks to a playlist has to be done one by one.
apps.whoFor: People who need to download specific tracks without subscriptions

apps.title: Top Radio - music, live news
apps.verdict: A light, battery-efficient radio app with a simple interface, but most stations do not work, there is no station search, the developer is not updating the app, and HLS is not supported.
apps.loved: Minimal resource use and a fast start set it apart from heavy radio players.
apps.weak: There is no station name search, making navigation through the catalog practically impossible.
apps.whoFor: Background radio listeners who want no extra settings

apps.title: Music : Simple Music Streaming
apps.verdict: The app lets you listen to YouTube music without a separate app, but it has a systemic limitation: music stops when the screen locks, making background playback non-functional for most use cases.
apps.loved: The ability to search and listen to tracks from YouTube directly in the app without downloading is appreciated for its convenience.
apps.weak: Playback stops when leaving the app or locking the screen, making walking and background listening impossible.
apps.whoFor: People who only listen to music with the screen on and do not step away from their phone

apps.title: YouTube
apps.verdict: This is a general-purpose video platform, not a music player: there is no dedicated catalog, no music discovery mechanics, and no audio focus. The recommendation algorithm is oriented toward video, not the listener.
apps.loved: A vast library of music videos and concert recordings not available on any music streaming service.
apps.weak: Music discovery is built around video, not audio: the algorithm mixes genres and surfaces AI-generated content.
apps.whoFor: Fans of music videos and concert recordings

apps.title: Melodista Music Offline Player
apps.verdict: Melodista offers the core offline player mechanics with playlist support, but metadata editing (track name, artwork, artist) consistently does not save, making library organization nearly impossible. The app has not received noticeable updates and it shows.
apps.loved: Clean playlist organization without extra steps for those who have already downloaded their music.
apps.weak: Tag and artwork editing does not save, and this bug has not been fixed for a long time.
apps.whoFor: Users with a ready mp3 collection who do not need to edit tags

apps.title: Equalizer+ HD music player
apps.verdict: The equalizer concept works, but the app fails to play some tracks, forgets the current position when minimized, and does not pass metadata over Bluetooth. For the price, more is expected.
apps.loved: A full multi-band equalizer with a visualizer for local files.
apps.weak: When minimized, the app loses the current track and requires searching again.
apps.whoFor: Music fans with local files who need a powerful equalizer

quotes.text: Hear your music like never before with this app's built in sound equalizer that cranks up the volume and raises the bass so headphones get the max usage. Also blend your tracks so it's like a dj is mixing your music personally just for you.

apps.title: Audius Music
apps.verdict: A blockchain platform for indie artists with an interesting concept but rough execution: track uploads have not worked for years, login hangs, and search plays something other than what you searched for. Listening to others' music is possible, but the catalog is narrow and playback quality is inconsistent.
apps.loved: Displays BPM and key directly on the track card, which DJs appreciate.
apps.weak: The catalog contains almost no well-known artists and discovery is nearly absent.
apps.whoFor: Independent artists looking for a SoundCloud alternative

apps.title: MX Video Player HD
apps.verdict: MX Video Player on iOS does not reach the level of its Android version: AirPlay in the paid version transmits audio only without video, there is no window resizing on iPad for large files, and video renaming does not work. Basic video player tasks are handled with caveats.
apps.loved: Support for common formats and organization of a local video library.
apps.weak: AirPlay in the paid version transmits audio only, making one of the key features useless.
apps.whoFor: Users who store local video files and do not use AirPlay

apps.title: Music IR‎ : Instant Rhythm
apps.verdict: A local player for the Iranian audience with radio station support and an offline collection, but recent updates have broken core functions: playlists were deleted, import stopped working, and lock screen controls disappeared. The current state is significantly worse than previous versions.
apps.loved: Before the last update, users valued the simple file import and the convenient lock screen widget.
apps.weak: After the major update, playback requires a constant internet connection even for local files, destroying the player's key advantage.
apps.whoFor: Iranian users looking for a convenient player with local radio station support

quotes.text: The new update is terrible. All my playlists were deleted and no new music will be imported. One star is too many

apps.title: Mureka: AI Radio & Music Maker
apps.verdict: The idea of AI radio and music generation is interesting, but the model consistently ignores voice gender selection, genre prompts, and does not properly finish tracks. The product has not yet reached a basic level of reliability.
apps.loved: You can try generating music from your own lyrics directly in the free version.
apps.weak: Voice settings and genre prompts are regularly ignored by the model and results are unpredictable.
apps.whoFor: Curious users willing to experiment with AI music without guarantees of results

apps.title: Music Player: MP3 Download
apps.verdict: A player with an extensive catalog for finding rare tracks and remixes, but downloads through the HMD section are unreliable: most tracks either do not download or play twice as long as their duration with silence at the end.
apps.loved: You can find obscure remixes and old-school tracks not on Spotify.
apps.weak: Downloads through the main HMD search module are unreliable: tracks either do not play or are duplicated with silence.
apps.whoFor: Music fans searching for rare and niche recordings

apps.title: Cloud Music Offline Player mp3
apps.verdict: The app lets you listen to local files from the cloud offline, but the link downloader is broken or locked behind a paid tier, shuffle playback does not work correctly, and tracks quietly add several minutes of silence. The basic player function holds, but everything else is falling apart.
apps.loved: Works without internet and does not show ads during playback.
apps.weak: The music link downloader either stops finding files or is blocked without a subscription.
apps.whoFor: People who store files in Dropbox and do not want to stream

apps.title: VidPlay - Music Video Streamer
apps.verdict: When it works, it offers a wide catalog and convenient playlists with no switching limits. The offline download feature periodically breaks for months, and users lose accumulated playlists when changing phones.
apps.loved: A large catalog with rare tracks and unlimited track switching without a subscription.
apps.weak: Downloaded playlists are not synced to an account and disappear when the device is changed or reset.
apps.whoFor: iPhone users who need a free player with a wide catalog and no Android alternative

apps.title: Music Player ‣
apps.verdict: Music Player is positioned as a local file player but most users come for streaming and are disappointed: search returns nothing, the catalog is extremely sparse, and many tracks are covered versions instead of originals.
apps.loved: Plays audio files from the device without ads in the player interface.
apps.weak: The streaming content catalog is too narrow: most popular tracks and artists are absent.
apps.whoFor: People who need a simple player for their own music files on iPhone

apps.title: Offline Music Player ‣‣
apps.verdict: A player app for pre-downloaded mp3 files with no built-in catalog or radio, making it extremely limited compared to competitors. Functionality is basic: import, playback, playlists, but even these operations draw complaints.
apps.loved: Simple organization of personal music without extra screens.
apps.weak: There is no built-in catalog or streaming. The app only works with pre-downloaded files.
apps.whoFor: People with an mp3 archive who do not use streaming

quotes.text: Didn't pay for anything you can download anything and play it but only while the apps open turn off your phone, switch apps, or even go to your Home Screen instantly stops playing
Please, I beg you to return the function of sorting by the number of times you listened to a song, this is a unique feature that other applications do not have, please return it.

apps.title: Mudify Archive: MP3 Download
apps.verdict: Mudify is positioned as a music downloader from archives, but search regularly returns the wrong results, downloads break or get disabled after updates, and the 60-track limit in the free version makes it pointless. Users observe regression year after year.
apps.loved: Offline playback with the screen locked works reliably once tracks are already downloaded.
apps.weak: Search does not recognize titles correctly and often returns random content instead of the requested track.
apps.whoFor: People searching for niche tracks not available on streaming services

apps.title: Discz: Discover & Share Music
apps.verdict: Discz was built on a swipe-based music discovery mechanic and a social profile, but an update removed profile customization, restricted swipes, and broke posts, destroying the reason people downloaded the app. The product core has degraded to the point where even loyal users describe it as 'dead'.
apps.loved: The swipe-based music discovery idea tied to the real tastes of other users was original.
apps.weak: The update removed profile customization and social posts, destroying the primary use case.
apps.whoFor: Nobody in its current state. Previously suited those looking for niche music through community recommendations

quotes.text: This is an amazing app for finding new music, I have found my favorite songs using this app. I think it would be a cool addition to add playlists in the saved songs.

They removed the only thing the app had brought the crowd for. You cannot be fun and decorate your profile anymore and it's honestly just dead now. They completely abandoned the app and not a single update since.

apps.title: Anime Music Collection
apps.verdict: A niche archive of anime music with a wide library that held together thanks to a community and chat, but has since degraded: the chat is gone, favorites crash, search does not work on iPhone, and the app has not been updated in three years.
apps.loved: A large collection of anime soundtracks in one place. Many users found rare tracks.
apps.weak: The Favorites section crashes on open, making the personal collection inaccessible.
apps.whoFor: Anime fans willing to tolerate technical decay

apps.title: Trending Music Player
apps.verdict: The app coasts on memory of what it was a few years ago: offline playback, simplicity, zero ads. After a series of updates, music stops playing, tracks disappear from playlists, and a password reset dropped the session mid-code-entry.
apps.loved: Offline playback without internet that used to work flawlessly for years.
apps.weak: Core playback reliability is broken: tracks disappear, the player freezes after one or two songs.

apps.title: Offline Pro: Files, Music
apps.verdict: Offline Pro used to save YouTube videos to the device, but the download function is broadly broken after API changes: most recent reviews report errors. Music stops when the screen locks, there is no shuffle, and a previously purchased subscription does not restore after reinstall.
apps.loved: When downloads work, saved files play cleanly without a network connection.
apps.weak: There is no shuffle for the downloads list, and playback stops when the screen locks.

apps.title: Boomplay: Music & Live Stream
apps.verdict: The African and Nigerian music catalog is incomplete and updates with a week or more of delay. Search is unstable: it finds artists but not their tracks.
apps.loved: Rare niche African content not available on other platforms.
apps.weak: The catalog updates with significant delay. New albums appear a week after release.

apps.title: Music X - Music Offline Player
apps.verdict: Music X attracts with a large catalog and the promise of offline playback, but ads pop up literally on every tap, YouTube playlists only display 100 of 500 tracks, and after updates the app stops switching tracks automatically.

apps.weak: After updates, auto-track-switching breaks and the app needs to be restarted manually after every song.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone in its current state

apps.title: Music Player : Songs Streaming

apps.weak: After every update all user playlists and history are lost.

apps.title: Offline Player – Music Player

apps.title: DailyTube : Videos, Music

apps.title: Music Player : Songs, Videos

apps.weak: Playback stops on its own after one or two tracks and the app must be restarted each time.
apps.whoFor: People who want to listen to YouTube music without a subscription

apps.title: FoxFM - Offline Video Player
apps.verdict: An offline player with a simple interface, but the central download function consistently does not work for most users, making the app's existence pointless. An aggressive ad stream finishes off an already weak experience.
apps.loved: Long-time users appreciate the simple navigation and the ability to store video and audio in one place.
apps.weak: File downloading has stopped working for most users and does not recover even after reinstall.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended in its current state

apps.title: Offline Music Player:Mp3&Video
apps.verdict: An offline player with decent content search, but the app periodically wipes the user's downloaded library entirely, making it an unreliable music store.
apps.loved: Offline playback works for those who managed to download tracks before the wipe.
apps.weak: The library and playlists can disappear without warning on app update or restart.

apps.title: Music X : Music Player & Mp3

apps.title: POPTube: Music & Video Podcast
apps.verdict: A YouTube client that most of the time shows a media load error. The issue is systemic and returns after every update. Reliability is so low that paying for a subscription makes no sense.
apps.loved: When it works, it delivers fewer ads than the official YouTube app.
apps.weak: Background playback is unstable, and a media load error appears without warning for days at a time.

apps.title: Gaana Music - Songs & Podcasts
apps.verdict: The catalog is thin even for Indian music, audio has no Hi-Fi option, the player freezes and does not switch tracks. A paid subscription does not fix any of these problems.

apps.title: Offline Music Player-MP3&Video
apps.verdict: The app calls itself an offline player but systematically requires a network connection to play even downloaded tracks. The core feature is fundamentally broken.
apps.loved: Users who managed to set up offline mode appreciate the simple playlist loading.

quotes.text: This app was the best offline music app i had for years but all of my music and playlists is wiped off but my chosen background and my search history stayed and i only offloaded the app like usual

apps.title: Musica XM-Offline Music Player
apps.verdict: Musica XM is so overloaded with ads that users report fake virus warnings and 60-second pre-roll ads before every track download. Downloads stop working after updates, tracks cut off mid-play. This is an ad display, not a music player.

apps.title: Offline Music ®

apps.title: Player GR Music Streamer iPlay
apps.verdict: The app lost its main advantage during a redesign: the old version could play YouTube links offline, the new version handles neither properly. Search is broken, tracks are cut off at 29 seconds.

apps.title: MyMixtapez: Playlists 24/7
apps.verdict: MyMixtapez has lost all core features: playlists are deleted after updates, search returns no results, music does not play, and track downloads have been removed. The current version is effectively a non-functional product with a rich history.
apps.loved: It used to be the best source for hip-hop mixtapes with the option to listen offline.
apps.weak: Playlists disappear after every major update, and playback does not work in most sessions.

quotes.text: I lost over 2000 songs because of the last update and I haven't used this app much since I can't even put into words how p!ssed I am my main playlist which was "favorites" was deleted gone after the update I can't remember all those songs 🤨 I've had this account for at least 15 years

apps.title: makromusic Dating for Spotify

apps.weak: The community is full of fake profiles. Finding real users is nearly impossible.

quotes.text: this app compiles all my music taste into one quick read, i love how it matches me with people that like the same music as me!

apps.title: MusicBox - MP3 Player&Offline

apps.loved: The idea of combining a large catalog in one free player is appealing in itself.

apps.title: offline music player - songs

apps.title: MusiChic-Offline Music Player

apps.title: Music Video Player Musca

scenarios.name: Classical music fans
scenarios.job: Find a specific work in the right performance and compare several recordings of the same symphony without digging through a rock-album interface.
scenarios.gap: The reviews ask for faster ways to find works and to compare performances. That is better tested on a particular composer and a long list of recordings.

scenarios.name: Collectors with a personal music library
scenarios.job: Play their own FLAC files and large cloud-drive collections with reliable CarPlay, gapless playback, and no fee for someone else’s catalog.
scenarios.gap: The scenario to test is starting a file from home on the phone, carrying on in the car and keeping the queue when the connection changes.

scenarios.name: Underground and DJ mix listeners
scenarios.job: Get access to unreleased tracks, demos, and DJ sets with full seeking and a clickable tracklist.
scenarios.gap: With a long mix it is worth testing the search for a fragment, the scrubbing and moving through the tracklist.

scenarios.name: Diaspora listeners of home radio
scenarios.job: Listen to home-country radio stations abroad in a stable stream with easy navigation across hundreds of stations and offline recording of broadcasts.
scenarios.gap: Reviews of radio players describe streams cutting out and requests for recording the broadcast. The starting scenario is switching on a familiar station quickly and getting the broadcast back after a dropout.

scenarios.name: Deliberate music lovers with big playlists
scenarios.job: Hear their entire collection instead of the same 20 tracks from a thousand-song playlist, and keep a listening diary with album ratings.
scenarios.gap: Test whether an order of the queue set by the user helps a large collection be heard in full, and whether the history helps people return to albums they have played.
